faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the North & Middle Andaman District recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the North & Middle Andaman District recruitment is 18th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies available for the posts of Programme Officer, Assistant Engineer, Data Entry Operator, and Gram Rozgar Sewak.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Gram Rozgar Sewak post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Gram Rozgar Sewak post is XII Pass from a recognized Board and a Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted via Email or Offline mode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator post is ₹14,000/- per month, which includes EPF.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection process steps?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test/Trade Test followed by a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to The Joint District Programme Coordinator, VB-G RAM G, O/o District Programme Coordinator (Deputy Commissioner), North & Middle Andaman District, Mayabunder - 744204.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.
